svg.title: The Millennium Problems · Figure 6 · The Grade Ledger: One Footing In The Kernel
svg.text: THE GRADE LEDGER: ONE FOOTING IN THE KERNEL
THEOREMS WITH A PINNED CONE, BY ROW MASTER, AND THE GRADE OF EACH BIT
premise on all seven rows in the kernel; the Poincaré delivery accepted as unconditional by the Clay Institute
Counts read each module's own pins: on no axiom, on propext with Quot.sound, on Lean's standard axioms. The five v1.1.0 rows rest wholly on no axiom; the RH
master reaches Lean's standard axioms through Mathlib's analysis, the P ≠ NP master through classical reasoning over machines.
